name: patch_ast
description: Surgically replaces a specific function or class node in a target Python file using AST parsing without full-file rewrites.

file_path.description: Path to the target Python source file.

target_node_name.description: Name of the target function (FunctionDef) or class (ClassDef) node to patch.

replacement_code.description: The complete Python code for the new function or class replacement.

validate_syntax.description: If true, validates that the patched file parses cleanly before saving.
